title: How to ask ChatGPT to explain any AI news headline in plain English
facebook: AI news can feel like a foreign language. The trick: paste any confusing headline into ChatGPT and ask it to explain why it matters to you. Here's a simple prompt that does the trick. https://aiworldhq.com/article/how-to-ask-chatgpt-to-explain-any-ai-news-headline-in-plain-english
